neighbours.label: the slot right before the outgoing destination of a signal or power path (from the spinal cord to the muscles, from the gearbox to the axle), as opposed to an inbound path toward the brain or hub
fire: Lower motor neurons pass the command from the ventral horn to the skeletal muscles of the thigh.
Efferent signals leave the medulla and travel to the salivary glands.
Sympathetic fibers carry impulses from the spinal cord to the sweat glands of the palm.
The phrenic nerve conveys orders from the neck to the diaphragm during each breath.
A chain delivers the power from the engine to the back wheel of the motorcycle.
Corticospinal axons project downward from the motor cortex to the hand muscles.
A long cable transmits the pull from the lever to the brake pads.
The propeller shaft sends torque from the transmission to the differential.
quiet: Sensory neurons pass the message from the skin of the thigh to the spinal cord.
Afferent signals leave the salivary glands and travel to the medulla.
Pain fibers carry impulses from the palm to the thalamus and the cortex.
The nerve reports stretch from the diaphragm to the brainstem during each breath.
A mechanic brought the invoice from the workshop to the owner of the motorcycle.
Ascending axons project upward from the hand to the somatosensory cortex.
A long hallway leads from the lobby to the staff kitchen.
The courier sent the parcel from the warehouse to the shop.

notes: Output: suppressed by the + pole, so this pole promotes output, outside, external, peripheral. Probes: motor out to muscles 1.18, efferent 1.08, spinal cord to the muscles 1.09, driveshaft 0.76; afferent toward brainstem 0.14, sensory to the brain 0.08, fingertip to brain 0.11, ticket to customer 0.01. The + pole reads as the other side: tokens before central structures (brain, spinal cord, pituitary). Not tested here.
